import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
data = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_palette("husl")

# 1. Sleep Duration by Occupation
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
occupation_sleep = data.groupby('Occupation')['Sleep Duration'].mean().sort_values(ascending=False)
occupation_sleep.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color='steelblue')
ax1.set_xlabel('Average Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax1.set_title('Average Sleep Duration by Occupation')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Quality of Sleep vs Sleep Duration
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
ax2.scatter(data['Sleep Duration'], data['Quality of Sleep'], 
           c=data['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax2.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)')
ax2.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep')
ax2.set_title('Sleep Quality vs Duration (colored by Stress Level)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(ax2.collections[0], ax=ax2)
cbar.set_label('Stress Level')
ax2.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 3. BMI Category Distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
bmi_counts = data['BMI Category'].value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set2', len(bmi_counts))
ax3.pie(bmi_counts.values, labels=bmi_counts.index, autopct='%1.1f%%', 
        colors=colors, startangle=90)
ax3.set_title('BMI Category Distribution')

# 4. Physical Activity Level by Gender
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
gender_activity = data.groupby('Gender')['Physical Activity Level'].mean()
gender_activity.plot(kind='bar', ax=ax4, color=['lightcoral', 'lightskyblue'])
ax4.set_ylabel('Average Physical Activity Level')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity Level by Gender')
ax4.set_xticklabels(ax4.get_xticklabels(), rotation=0)
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Daily Steps vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
scatter = ax5.scatter(data['Daily Steps'], data['Heart Rate'], 
                     c=data['Age'], cmap='viridis', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax5.set_xlabel('Daily Steps')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate')
ax5.set_title('Daily Steps vs Heart Rate (colored by Age)')
cbar = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax5)
cbar.set_label('Age')
ax5.grid(alpha=0.3)

# 6. Sleep Disorder Distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
sleep_disorder = data['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None')
disorder_counts = sleep_disorder.value_counts()
colors = sns.color_palette('Set3', len(disorder_counts))
ax6.bar(range(len(disorder_counts)), disorder_counts.values, color=colors)
ax6.set_xticks(range(len(disorder_counts)))
ax6.set_xticklabels(disorder_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax6.set_ylabel('Count')
ax6.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution')
ax6.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 7. Stress Level Distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(data['Stress Level'], bins=10, color='salmon', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Stress Level')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax7.set_title('Stress Level Distribution')
ax7.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Age Distribution
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1])
ax8.hist(data['Age'], bins=15, color='mediumseagreen', edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax8.set_xlabel('Age')
ax8.set_ylabel('Frequency')
ax8.set_title('Age Distribution')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 9. Correlation Heatmap
ax9 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 2])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = data[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0,
            square=True, ax=ax9, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax9.set_title('Correlation Matrix')

plt.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset Analysis', fontsize=16, y=0.995, fontweight='bold')

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
